intermediate.name: Croce di Casale
intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (3) Croce di Casale (60.9 km)
Red Bull KM Sprint | Castel Santa Maria (177.4 km)

story: Intense action marked the early kilometres before a large breakaway formed. The peloton rode at a steady pace, while four riders escaped from the front group approaching Montelago. With just over 500 metres to the summit, Plapp accelerated and rode solo for 45.5 km to claim the stage. Ulissi took the maglia rosa from Roglic.
